blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
This report examines and compares some of the many fine tuning and prompting methods existing, applying them within the domain of autonomous driving. The idea is to compare these methods by adapting a Large Language Model (LLM) on a video dataset. LLM’s have become extremely good at achieving a good understanding of different forms of data and this study aims to induce a low dimensional understanding of driving situations into our primary test model SpaceTimeGPT. Experiments on BDD-X (Berkeley DeepDrive
eXplanation) dataset demonstrate good performance of the full fine tuning framework on some automatic metrics, and in some metrics, it even surpasses the baseline. We also try Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and prompt engineering on VideoLLaVA model and discuss its limitations.
blocks.zh:
本报告审查并比较了现有的许多微调和激励方法中的一些方法,将其应用于自主驾驶领域。 这个想法是通过在视频数据集上修改一个大语言模型(LLM)来比较这些方法. LLM在很好地了解不同形式数据方面已经变得极为出色,本研究旨在引导低维度了解驱动情况,进入我们的主要测试模型SpaceTimeGPT。 BDD-X(伯克利深潜飞行器)上的实验
eXplanation)数据集显示在一些自动度量衡上完整微调框架的性能良好,在一些度量衡上甚至超过了基准. 我们还尝试Low-Rank适应(Lora),并迅速对VideoLLAVA模型进行工程,并讨论其局限性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Driving video captioning is an important problem. Despite being effective, the lack of interpretability often limits our understanding of what goes on under the hood in the neural network approaches of these captioning models. An effective method of captioning and understanding can have several use cases in domain of Autonomous Driving. Firstly, this would allow text-based searching for interesting scenarios in a database. Secondly, the ability to express understanding in natural language would bridge the gap between an end user, who has limited knowledge of intelligent systems, and the machine’s behaviour. Thirdly, language can be looked at as a high-level representation for rule learning. There is a need for such representations and language is one such way to have short representations which nonetheless contain the things important for the decision making. Therefore, this could be an important step also towards better (representation) learning for driving. Fourth, this could make it easier to check to what extent a dataset of given scenarios covers a given operational design domain. We achieve this by using multiple encoder-decoder couples and cutting-edge LLM’s for feature understanding in the videos. We also experiment with different adaptation methods and create a nice spectra of possible ways to achieve our objectives.
blocks.zh: 驾驶视频字幕是一个重要问题。 尽管有效,但缺乏可解释性常常限制了我们对这些字幕模型的神经网络方法的引擎盖下发生的事情的理解. 一种有效的标题和理解方法在自主驾驶领域可以有几个使用的案例。 首先,这将允许在数据库中以文字搜索有趣的情景。 其次,用自然语言表达理解的能力将弥合对智能系统了解有限的最终用户与机器行为之间的差距。 第三,语言可以看作是规则学习的高级别代表。 有必要提出这种陈述,而语言是提出简短陈述的一种方式,虽然简短陈述包含了对决策很重要的内容。 因此,这也可以是改善驾驶学习(代表性)的一个重要步骤。 第四,这可以更容易地检查特定情景数据集在多大程度上涵盖特定业务设计领域。 使用多对编码器-解码器配对, 我们还试验了不同的适应方法,并创造了实现我们的目标的可能方法的良好的光谱。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Notable related work in the domain includes ADAPT [ 1 ] which also uses the same dataset we use, BDD-X [ 2 ] , for their experimentation.
blocks.zh: 这个领域的显著相关工作包括ADAPT[1],它也使用我们使用的相同的数据集BDD-X[2],用于他们的实验.

blocks.en: ADAPT or Action-aware Driving Caption Transformer introduces a transformer architecture for captioning of driving videos. Just like our experiments, ADAPT addresses explainability and interpretability in this domain. They use a novel approach of jointly training driving caption task along with vehicular control prediction task by using a shared video representation. Since it is then expressed linguistically, it makes it easy to understand what is going on in the videos when compared to previous vision or LiDAR based approaches. The framework is then assessed on the BDD-X dataset. It results in state-of-the-art performance on automatic metrics and human evaluation. The paper includes a detailed ablation study analysing the impact of the different aspects of the design of this framework, different sampling rates and different control signal types. The authors also talk about the pipeline they developed to deploy this ADAPT framework in both simulator environments and the real world. This can facilitate real time conversion of raw driving video input into natural language. ADAPT is a direct motivation for us on this project. There were certain hurdles (eg. the docker setup limitations) which did not allow us to directly work with the ADAPT code and update it.
blocks.zh: ADAPT或Action-aware Criversion Caption Transformer引入了驱动视频字幕的变压器架构. 与我们的实验一样,ADAPT也涉及这个领域的可解释性和可解释性。 他们使用一种新颖的方法,即联合培训驾驶字幕任务和车辆控制预测任务,使用共享的视频表示。 与之前的视觉或基于LiDAR的方法相比, 然后在BDD-X数据集上评估该框架。 它在自动度量衡和人类评价方面产生了最先进的性能。 论文包括一项详细分析本框架设计不同方面的影响,不同采样率和不同控制信号类型的分析研究. 作者们还谈到了他们为在模拟环境和现实世界中部署这一ADAPT框架而开发的管道. 这可以促进将原始驱动视频输入的实时转换为自然语言. ADAPT是这个项目的直接动机。 有一些障碍(例如插头设置限制),使我们无法直接使用ADAPT代码并更新它。

blocks.en: Wayve has released a research paper titled "GAIA-1: A Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving" [ 3 ] that explores the challenges of building autonomous driving systems, while focusing primarily on the problem of effectively predicting outcomes in response to the vehicle’s actions in an evolving world. The paper introduces GAIA-1, a generative world model that leverages video, text, and action inputs to generate realistic driving scenarios while offering control over ego-vehicle behavior and scene characteristics. Further, Wayve also released LINGO-2 which according to their website, is "the first closed-loop vision-language-action driving model (VLAM) tested on public roads". However, there is no publication available as of now. There is a previous paper on LingoQA [ 4 ] , which works towards the same direction.
blocks.zh: Wayve发布了一份题为"GAIA-1:一个通用的自主驾驶世界模式"的研究论文[3],其中探讨了建设自主驾驶系统的挑战,同时主要侧重于针对汽车在不断变化的世界中的行动而有效预测结果的问题. 本文介绍了GAIA-1,这是一种基因世界模型,利用视频、文字和行动投入生成现实的驱动情景,同时对自我车辆行为和场景特征进行控制。 此外,Wayve还发布了LINGO-2,根据他们的网站,这是"第一个在公共道路上测试的闭路视觉语言动作驾驶模型(VLAM)". 然而,目前还没有出版物。 之前有一篇关于LingoQA[4]的论文,它朝着同一方向工作.

blocks.en: 4 Approaches
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: The most important underlying mechanism for our experiments is the transformer architecture. Transformers have achieved state-of-the-art performance in various NLP tasks, including language translation, text summarization, and sentiment analysis, because of their ability to capture long-range dependencies and contextual information efficiently.
blocks.zh: 我们实验最重要的基础机制是变压器架构. 变形器在各种NLP任务中实现了最先进的性能,包括语言翻译,文本概括,和情绪分析,因为他们能够高效地捕捉远程依赖性和背景信息.

blocks.en: In the ViViT paper [ 5 ] , using these kind of transformer models for video classification was studied. In order to handle the long sequences of tokens in video data, they propose many efficient variants of the model to factorise the spatial- and temporal-dimensions of the input.
blocks.zh: 在ViViT纸[5]中,研究了使用这种变压器模型进行视频分类. 为了处理视频数据中的长序符,他们提出了许多高效的模型变体,以将输入的空间和时间差异因素化.

blocks.en: The table in Figure 2 in the supplementary material sums up some key differences between classic text transformers and video transformers.
blocks.zh: 补充材料图2中的表格总结了经典文本变压器和视频变压器之间的一些关键差异.

blocks.en: The approaches taken are discussed in two different sections: Pre-trained Models and Adaptation Methods.
blocks.zh: 所采取的方法在两个不同章节中讨论:培训前模式和适应方法。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pre-trained Models:
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训前模式:

blocks.en: A pre-trained model is a machine learning model that has already been trained on a large dataset for a particular task beforehand. They can be used as a starting point for other tasks by transferring their previous knowledge into the new problem at hand. This can be effectively achieved by fine-tuning them either completely or by freezing certain layers.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的模型是机器学习模型,它已经为特定任务接受了大型数据集的培训。 它们可以通过将以前的知识转移到手头的新问题中来作为其他任务的起点. 可以通过完全调整或冻结某些层来有效实现这一目标。

blocks.en: In our experimentation, we work with TimesFormer GPT-2, which is pretrained on the VaTeX (public dataset containing diverse video captioning and description instances) [ 6 ] . The other model (VideoLLaVA) gets its pretraining datasets from multiple sources. The image pretraining is done on the LLAVA [ 7 ] dataset and the video pretraining is done on the VALLEY [ 8 ] dataset. The next sections summarises the different pretrained models that we use either off the shelf or with some sort of adaptation in our experimentation.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们与TimesFormer GPT-2合作,后者在VaTeX(包含各种视频字幕和描述实例的公共数据集)上预训[6]. 另一个模型(VideoLLaVA)从多个来源获得其预训数据集. 图像预训在LLAVA[7]数据集上完成,视频预训在VALLEY[8]数据集上完成. 接下来的章节总结了不同的预先训练的模型,我们要么在架子外使用,要么在实验中进行某种改造.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 TimeSformer GPT-2
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 原时间SPT-2

blocks.en: TimeSformer GPT-2 or TFGPT2 is an extension of the GPT-2 architecture integrating temporal information into its model, which is done by using the TimeSformer [ 9 ] model. By incorporating time dependent structure X p ​ i ​ x X_{pix} alongside textual data, This model enhances the understanding of sequential data. This makes it particularly useful for tasks involving time-series data or sequential information such as stock market prediction, video analysis, or natural language generation. The main idea is to develop upon the success of GPT-2 in generating coherent and contextually relevant text while also accounting for temporal dynamics, leading to improved performance in tasks which can benefit with understanding of time. In essence, this model is basically an encoder-decoder couple, where the encoder is "facebook/timesformer-base-finetuned-k600" from the Huggingface model repository and the decoder is "gpt2". In the TimeSformer paper [ 9 ] , the authors have included a comparison between five space-time self-attention schemes: Space Attention, Joint Space-Time Attention, Divided Space-Time Attention, Sparse Local Global Attention and Axial Attention. Out of these, Divided Space-Time Attention achieves the best results. Compared to 3D CNN’s, the TimeSformer is a much improved model because CNN’s have strong inductive biases like local connectivity and translation invariance. These characteristics are beneficial for small datasets but not in our use case. Local connectivity means that the neurons in a layer are connected only to a local region of input. Translation invariance means that a shift in the input image pixel values results in a proportionate shift in output pixel values. The TimeSformer has a large learning capacity in spite of its low inference cost. This facilitates increasing model capacity and means that the TimeSformer scales fairly well and is quicker to train compared to CNN’s [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: TimeSformer GPT-2或TIFPT2是GPT-2架构的一个扩展,将时间信息纳入其模型中,通过使用TimeSformer[9]模型完成. 通过将时间依赖结构X p i x QQpix}与文本数据结合, 这个模型增强了对顺序数据的理解. 这使得它对于涉及时间序列数据或股票市场预测,视频分析,或自然语言生成等顺序信息的任务特别有用. 主要的想法是利用GPT-2在生成一致和符合具体情况的文本方面的成功经验,同时考虑时间动态,从而改进任务的执行情况,从而在了解时间后受益。 从本质上讲,这个模型基本上是编码器-解码器的一对,其中编码器是来自Huggingface模型存储器的"facebook/timesformer-base-finetuned-k600",解码器是"gpt2". 在TimeS前论文[9]中,作者对5个时空自学计划进行了比较: 空间注意,空间-时间联合注意,空间-时间分开注意,空间局部全球注意和轴心注意。 其中,分散的时空注意力能取得最佳效果。 与3D CNN相比, TimeSformer是一个大有改进的模型, 这些特性对小型数据集有利,但对我们的使用并不有利。 局部连通是指一层中的神经元仅与局部输入区域相连. 翻译偏移是指输入图像像素值的转变导致输出像素值的成比例变化. TimeSformer的学习能力很大,尽管其推论成本较低. 与CNN的[10]相比,

blocks.en: 4.1.2 TimeSformer BERT
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 前贝特时间

blocks.en: We also use the TimeSformer BERT model, which is basically the TimeSformer model in conjunction with the BERT language model [ 11 ] . It is slightly less powerful than the GPT-2 version, as we will see later in the experiments section.
blocks.zh: 我们还使用TimeSformer BERT模型,它基本上是TimeSformer模型结合BERT语言模型[11]. 它的功率略低于GPT-2版本,我们稍后将在实验部分看到这一点.

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Video-LLaVA
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 视频LLAVA

blocks.en: Video-LLaVA [ 12 ] , also known as Large-scale visual language is a model to better understand and process images and videos and is a powerful AI model designed to bridge the gap between how computers see and understand the world compared to humans. By converting video information into a format similar to text, Video-LLaVA can analyze videos like a large language model analyzes text. This allows it to deeply understand and consequently, grasp the content of a video as present in X p ​ i ​ x X_{pix} , including the actions and objects within it much more effectively than previous models. Additionally, a prompt X t ​ e ​ x X_{tex} can be included. This allows for improved understanding which is key to applications like video summarization, generating captions, and answering questions based on video content. The training pipeline consists of two separate stages : image/video understanding and then instruction tuning.
blocks.zh: Video-LlaVA [12],又称大规模视觉语言,是一种能更好理解和处理图像和视频的模型,是一种强大的AI模型,旨在弥合计算机与人类相比如何看待和理解世界之间的差距. 通过将视频信息转换成类似于文本的格式,Video-LLaVA可以像大语言模型那样分析视频分析文本. 这使得它能够深刻理解并因此把握X p i x QQpix}中的视频内容,包括其中的动作和对象比以前的模型要有效得多. 此外,还可以包括一个快捷的 X t e x {tex}。 这有助于增进对视频汇总等应用的关键理解,生成标题,并根据视频内容回答问题。 培训管道由两个不同的阶段组成:图像/视频理解和然后指令调试。

blocks.en: 4.2 Adaptation Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 适应方法

blocks.en: The two major adaptation methods we experiment with are the full fine tuning and the LoRA. We also try to engineer prompts for the bigger Video-LLaVA model.
blocks.zh: 我们试验的两种主要的适应方法是全微调和LORA. 我们还尝试为更大的Video-LLAVA模型设计提示.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Full-fine tuning

Classic full fine-tuning comprises of adjustment of the parameters θ \theta of a pre-trained model to adapt it to a specific task by training it on the dataset D D for target task of driving video captioning. This process begins with a pre-trained model M M that has preciously been trained on a large and diverse dataset. Then, some layers may be frozen to encourage the model to remember key broad details from previous task. After this, the final layers (which presumably contain finer and task specific information) are replaced to fit the new task. This new network is then trained, using the new dataset D D . This gives us a new set of weights and biases which are eventually used by the model to perform target task. An essential part of this is the use of an appropriate optimization algorithm (such as stochastic gradient descent) and the right loss function. Classic full fine tuning results in better performance on the new task than pretrained model [ 13 ] . However, the process is often slow and requires significant compute power, especially for large models like the modern LLM’s. There is also a high risk of overfitting in case the dataset is not large enough.
blocks.zh: 经典的全微调包括调整一个预先训练过的模型的参数 \\theta,以适应一项具体任务,方法是对它进行关于D数据集的培训,以完成驾驶视频字幕的目标任务。 这一过程从一个经过预先培训的M M模型开始,该模型在大型和多样化的数据集上得到了宝贵的培训。 然后,一些层层可能会被冻结,以鼓励模型记住以前任务中的关键的广义细节. 在此之后,最后一层(可能包含更精细和具体任务的信息)被替换,以适应新的任务. 然后使用新的数据集DD对这个新的网络进行培训。 这给了我们一套新的权重和偏见,最终被模型用来完成目标任务. 其中一个基本部分是使用适当的优化算法(如斜坡梯度下降)和正确的损失函数。 经典的全精细调试,使得新任务的表现优于预训模式[13]. 然而,这一过程往往很慢,需要很大的计算功率,特别是对于像现代LLM的大型模型来说. 此外,如果数据集不够大,还存在过于适应的高风险。

Let θ 0 \theta_{0} be all θ \theta that are already present and Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta be the new additional parameters to be trained. Usually, in any kind of fine tuning, the model is initialized with pretrained weights θ 0 \theta_{0} and updated to θ 0 + Δ ​ θ \theta_{0}+\Delta\theta .
In the case of full fine tuning, we do not learn a different set of parameters Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta . Therefore, | Δ ​ θ | |\Delta\theta| here is | θ 0 | |\theta_{0}| as the initial parameters itself are further trained.

在完全微调的情况下,我们不会学习不同的参数 QQ\\Delta\theta。 因此,由于初始参数本身已经进一步训练,所以这里的“Delta \theta ” 是“0 ” 。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Low-Rank Adaptation fine tuning
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 低倾角适应微调

blocks.en: LoRA fine-tuning [ 14 ] is a method that fine tunes more efficiently by introducing low-rank matrices into selected layers, while keeping most parameters fixed. This approach starts with a pre-trained model M M . Most of the parameters stay fixed and hold the model’s knowledge from the previous task. Then, we introduce low-rank matrices into some layers. This new architecture is then trained on the dataset D D . These matrices capture the information that helps the model perform better on the new task. Like full fine-tuning, it is of prime importance to use the right optimization algorithm and loss function for the target task. Since we train only the newly added low rank matrices, while keeping the rest of the parameters fixed, LoRA is much more efficient computationally and also takes lesser time and memory. Further, there is also a lesser risk of over-fitting, since majority of the parameters are unchanged. In this way, LoRA allows us to quickly adapt pretrained models for new target tasks.
blocks.zh: LoRA微调[14]是一种通过将低级矩阵引入到选定的层中,同时保持大多数参数固定,从而提高微调效率的方法. 这种方法始于经过预先培训的MM型. 多数参数保持不变,并保留了该模型对前一个任务的知识。 然后,我们把低级矩阵引入一些层次。 这个新架构随后在数据集DD上得到训练. 这些矩阵捕捉有助于模型更好地完成新任务的信息。 和完全微调一样,对目标任务使用正确的优化算法和损失函数至关重要. 由于我们只训练新添加的低阶矩阵,同时保留其余参数固定,所以LORA在计算上效率要高得多,而且花费的时间和内存也更少. 此外,过度调整的风险也较小,因为大多数参数没有变化。 这样,LORA可以让我们快速调整预训模型,用于新的目标任务.

blocks.en: In the second part of the experiments, we implement LoRA on our target dataset D D . This is a much more parameter-efficient approach, which allows the task specific parameter increment Δ ​ θ = Δ ​ θ ​ ( α ) \Delta\theta=\Delta\theta(\alpha) to be further encoded by a small number of parameters α \alpha . The dimensionality of the parameter vector α \alpha is much smaller than the dimensionality of the original parameter vector θ 0 \theta_{0} . | α | << | θ 0 | |\alpha|<<|\theta_{0}|
blocks.zh: 在实验的第二部分,我们执行LORA 我们的目标数据集DD。 这是一个更具有参数效率的方法,它允许任务特定参数增量 QQ = QQ (α)\Delta\theta\Delta\theta (\alpha) 由少量参数 α\ alpha 进一步编码. 参数矢量α\alpha的维度远小于原始参数矢量→0\theta\0}的维度.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Prompt Engineering and In-context learning
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 即时工程和文本学习

blocks.en: In-context learning is an adaptation method where a pre-trained model learns how to perform better on a new target task by looking at examples of how its output should be. There are many different forms of in-context learning, like zero shot learning, one shot learning or many shot learning. In each of these, there is either zero, one or many examples included in the prompt, for the model to learn from. This, along with the query for the new task, leads the model to the right output. The approach allows the model to understand the context and generate responses based on the formats of the example/s provided. This method is frequently used as it hardly takes any further computational resources. The strong limitation of this method is that it is bound by the pre-existing knowledge of the model and the quality of examples in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 内涵学习是一种适应方法,一种经过预先训练的模型通过查看其产出应该如何的例子来学习如何更好地完成新的目标任务. 有多种不同形式的内语学习,如零镜头学习,一镜头学习或许多镜头学习. 在每一个例子中,都有零,一个或许多例子包含在提示中,供模型学习. 这与新任务的查询一起,将模型引向正确的输出. 这种方法使模型能够了解上下文,并根据所提供实例/实例的格式生成答复。 这种方法经常使用,因为它几乎不需要任何进一步的计算资源。 这种方法的强烈局限在于它受对模型的事先了解和迅速中实例的质量的约束.

blocks.en: Prompt engineering is an adaption method that improves performance on a task by customising the input prompts. In this type of adaptation, there is no change in the underlying parameters; instead, we leverage the pre-existing knowledge and logical understanding of the model. The prompt may be crafted to contain particular instructions or examples that nudges the LLM to outputting the desired behaviour based on task requirement. Prompt engineering requires no further computational resources as it only involves manipulation of the input text. However, as we see later on, the success of prompt engineering can be limited by the model’s inherent capabilities and the quality of the crafted prompts. On the TimeSformer-GPT2, we experiment with the classic fine tuning and the LoRA while on the larger Video-LLaVA model, we tried a couple of different prompt engineering techniques. The full fine tuning and LoRA for Video-LLaVA could not be completed due to time and computational restraints.
blocks.zh: 即时工程是一种适应方法,通过自定义输入提示来提高任务性能. 在这类适应中,基本参数没有变化;相反,我们利用了对模型的原有知识和逻辑理解。 该提示可能旨在包含特定指示或实例,使LLM能够根据任务要求输出所期望的行为. 即时工程不需要更多的计算资源,因为它只涉及对输入文本的操纵. 然而,正如我们后来所看到的那样,迅速工程的成功可能受模型内在的能力和精心制作的提示的质量的限制。 在TimeSformer-GPT2上,我们实验了经典的微调和LORA,而在更大的Video-LLaVA模型上,我们尝试了几种不同的快速工程技术. 由于时间和计算限制,Video-LLAVA的全微调和LORA无法完成。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We experiment with the BDD100K and the BDDX datasets for our tasks. They are both widely used datasets in the domain of autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 我们用BDD100K和BDDX数据集来实验我们的任务. 它们都是自主驾驶领域广泛使用的数据集.

blocks.en: 5.1 BDD100K
blocks.zh: 5.1 BDD100K 数据

blocks.en: BDD100K [ 15 ] , or Berkeley Deep Drive 100K, is an important resource in the realm of computer vision and autonomous driving. It contains 100,000 videos, each about 40s long, and the format is 720p at 60 frames per second. The videos are collected and recorded all over the United States. This gives us a great mix of different circumstances such as city streets to countryside scenes. The dataset is labeled at a key-frame from every 10th second and have detailed annotations attached. This includes image tagging, bounding boxes and image segmentation details. There is also further information on road object detection. For our auxiliary task, we use this dataset to try and predict weather, surroundings and time of day columns as present in the dataset. We do this to gauge the level of understanding of the TimeSformer model. The results of this auxiliary task is presented in the supplementary section.
blocks.zh: BDD100K [15],或Berkeley Deep Drive 100K,是计算机视觉和自主驱动领域的重要资源. 包含10万段视频,每段长约40s,格式为720p,每秒60帧. 这些视频在美国各地收集和录制. 这给了我们很多不同的环境,比如城市街道到乡村场景. 数据集以每10秒键框标注,并附有详细的说明。 这包括图像标记、边框和图像分割细节。 还有关于公路物体探测的进一步资料。 对我们的辅助任务来说,我们使用这个数据集来尝试并预测数据集中存在的天气,周围和日列的时间. 我们这样做是为了衡量对TimeSformer模型的理解程度. 这一辅助任务的结果见补充部分。

blocks.en: 5.2 BDDX
blocks.zh: 5.2 BDDX 数据交换

blocks.en:
BDDX or Berkeley Deep Drive X [ 2 ] , is a unique dataset. It consists of video-label pairs and is one of the few datasets available that allows a model to learn captioning in the autonomous driving domain. BDDX has over 77 hours of driving videos spread across 7000 videos. These videos are tapes under a wide range of weather conditions such as rain, snow, sun. Just like the BDD100K, there is a plethora of videos for different situations, such as, overtakes, intersections, and simple speeding up.
There is a pre-defined training/validation/testing split of the dataset. To process these videos in an easier manner, we preprocess dataset D D to contain video names directly and make each row a segment. In this form, dataset D has 5 total columns: a column containing video name, and the corresponding segment labels (start time, end time, caption, reasoning).
blocks.zh:
BDDX或Berkeley Deep Drive X [2],是一个独特的数据集. 它由视频标签对组成,是少数可用的数据集之一,它允许一个模型在自主驱动域学习字幕. BDDX拥有超过77小时的驱动视频,传播到7000个视频. 这些视频是在雨,雪,太阳等广泛天气条件下的磁带. 与BDD100K一样,对于不同的情况,如超标,交叉点,以及简单的加速等,也有大量的视频.
数据集有预定义的训练/验证/测试分解. 为了更容易地处理这些视频,我们预先处理数据集DD,直接包含视频名称,并使每行成为一段. 在这个表单中,数据集D共有5个总列:一个包含视频名称的列,以及相应的片段标签(起始时间,结束时间,标题,推理).

blocks.en:
We can introduce BDDX as our primary dataset D D and break it down into its contents. The contents are:
- the videos, X (the dataset itself contains video links which directly correspond to video names from a complete data pool of videos from BDD100K)
- the corresponding labels, Y (consists of start time, end time, caption and reasoning for each segment of the video)
blocks.zh:
我们可以引入BDDX作为我们的主要数据集DD并将其细分为内容. 内容是:
- 视频,X(数据集本身包含视频链接,直接对应BDD100K的完整视频数据库中的视频名称)
- 相应的标签,Y(包括视频每一段的开始时间、结束时间、标题和推理)

blocks.en: For our primary task, we try to predict captions that not only generate the action taken by the vehicle but also some sort of understanding as to why it takes it.
blocks.zh: 就我们的首要任务而言,我们试图预测各种标题,这些标题不仅产生车辆采取的行动,而且对车辆为何要采取行动有某种理解。

blocks.en: The four primary metrics we test on are the BLEU-4, CIDEr, METEOR and ROUGE-L. The CIDEr metric lies between 0 and 1000 while the rest are between 0 and 100.
blocks.zh: 我们测试的四项主要指标是BLEU-4、CIDER、METEOR和ROUGE-L。 CIDER指标在0至1000之间,其余在0至100之间。

blocks.en: Our first try is with the TFGPT2. In Table 1 , we find the comparison between all the methods we experimented on.
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个尝试是TFTPT2。 在表1中,我们发现我们试验的所有方法的比较。

blocks.en: Table 1: Metric scores
blocks.zh: 表1:计量分数

blocks.en: Initially, we compare the TF-GPT2 and TF-BERT pretrained models.Then comes the fully finetuned versions of the TFGPT2 and TF-BERT models. In the next part, we compare the different LoRA configurations for the TFGPT2 model. LoRA models can be modified by changing rank r and scaling factor alpha. We take a constant alpha and play around with the rank.
blocks.zh: 最初,我们比较TF-GPT2和TF-BERT预训模型. 然后是FINTPT2和TF-BERT模型的完全微调版本。 在下一部分中,我们比较了FITAPT2模型的不同LORA配置. LoRA模型可以通过改变等级r和缩放系数α来修改. 我们拿一个恒常的阿尔法 和周围的军衔。

blocks.en: Then, we examine different prompt engineering techniques for the Video-LLaVA. The prompts that we experimented on and used are : Prompt number 1 P1: "What action does the car take and why do you think it takes this action?" Prompt number 2 P2: "What action does the car take and why? Please respond in one sentence in this format: ’The car takes (action) because (reasoning).’ Include specific details about the traffic signals, road conditions, and any relevant environmental factors." Prompt number 3 P3: "Describe the car’s action and reasoning in one sentence in the following format: ’The car takes (action) because (reasoning).’ Include details about the surrounding conditions and factors influencing the action."
blocks.zh: 然后,我们为Video-LLAVA研究不同的即时工程技术. 我们试验并使用的提示是: 1 P1:"汽车采取了什么行动,你为什么认为它采取了这一行动?" 2 P2号提示器:"该车采取了什么行动,为什么? 请用这种格式回答一句话:`汽车之所以采取(行动)是因为(理由)'。 包括交通信号,道路条件,以及任何相关环境因素的具体细节". 提示号3 P3: " 用以下格式用一句话描述汽车的动作和推理: ' 汽车之所以采取(动作)是因为(理由). " 包括周围条件和影响动作的因素的细节".

blocks.en: The discussion of comparison between the methods is in the next section.
blocks.zh: 关于方法比较的讨论见下一节。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and analysis
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和分析

blocks.en: 6.1 Discussion of methods
blocks.zh: 6.1 关于方法的讨论

blocks.en: 6.1.1 Pretrained models
blocks.zh: 6.1.1 联合国 预选型号

blocks.en: As expected, the pretrained models fall well short in the driving captioning and understanding task. This is because the data it is pretrained on is very different and having not looked at the new dataset, the model has no idea what to look for in the videos and structure of the video shot. In driving, video is always shot from the ego vehicle point of view. Here, we also see that the GPT2 version of TimeSformer is seemingly more expressive, because of the higher number of parameters present.
blocks.zh: 如预期,预先训练的模型在驾驶字幕和理解任务方面远远不够。 这是因为它预先训练的数据非常不同,在没有查看新数据集的情况下,模型不知道在视频拍摄的视频和结构中要寻找什么. 在驾驶中,视频总是从自负车的角度拍摄. 在这里,我们也看到TimeSformer的GPT2版本似乎更具有表现力,因为现在的参数较多.

blocks.en: 6.1.2 Full fine tuning
blocks.zh: 6.1.2 国家 完全微调

blocks.en: After first epoch of fine-tuning, the model seems to act as if the task is binary classification. With time and some more epochs, the model becomes more expressive and it becomes more like a multi-class classification task. It learns the most frequent outputs first, and the expressiveness and detail come only with the last few epochs of training.
blocks.zh: 在第一个微调时代之后,该模型似乎起到了类似任务二进制分类的作用. 随着时间的推移和一些更划时代的推移,模型变得更加表现性,更像一个多类的分类任务. 它首先学习最频繁的产出,表现和细节只随着最后几个时代的训练而来.

blocks.en: 6.1.3 LoRA fine tuning
blocks.zh: 6.1.3 罗拉微调

blocks.en: Not all layers are trainable using LoRA. The first iterations using linear layers did not yield the desired outputs, as we saw repetitive outputs and unexpected sentence structures pop up. Finally, we settled on using linear, embedding and 1D and 2D convolution layers and this improved the outputs.
blocks.zh: 并非所有的地层都可以使用LORA进行训练. 使用线性图层的第一批迭代没有产生预期的输出,因为我们看到重复输出和意外的句子结构冒出来. 最后,我们决定使用线性、嵌入式和1D和2D演化层,这改善了产出。

blocks.en: 6.1.4 Prompt engineering
blocks.zh: 6.1.4 快速工程

blocks.en: Prompt engineering in general seems to not perform too well here. We tried 3 different prompts ranging from simple to more complex. The performance definitely improves but it does not even come close to the outputs of the fine tuning.
blocks.zh: 这里的快速工程似乎表现不佳 我们尝试了三个不同的提示,从简单到复杂。 业绩确实有所改善,但甚至没有接近微调的产出。

blocks.en: 6.2 Discussion of results
blocks.zh: 6.2 讨论结果

blocks.en: As expected, the full fine tuning outperforms the other experiments in all the metrics. It even outperforms some of the ADAPT metrics, which is appreciable because we achieve it with limited hardware and nonspecialist models made to understand the domain purely by adaptation. For the different LoRA, it seems that the model has issues with fitting as the different configurations seem to give similar results.
blocks.zh: 如所料,完全的微调超过了所有度量中的其他实验. 它甚至超过了一些ADAPT的度量标准,这是相当可观的,因为我们通过有限的硬件和非专业模型实现它,这些模型是纯粹通过适应来理解域的。 对于不同的LORA来说,这个模型似乎有些问题,因为不同的配置似乎产生类似的结果.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We see a glimpse of the power of the modern language models. Inspite of TimeSformer-GPT2 being much smaller and less complex than the ADAPT architecture, it performs comparably on many of the metrics. With further data, the capability of these models can be maximised. Also, more capable models like Video-LLaVA can be inspected and fine-tuned for driving video captioning and understanding. Although that does require significant computational resources and time, it should yield appreciable results.
blocks.zh: 我们看到现代语言模型的力量的一瞥. 尽管TimeSformer-GPT2比ADAPT架构小得多,也不太复杂,但是它在许多度量衡上具有可比性。 有了进一步的数据,这些模型的能力就可以最大化。 此外,还可以对Video-LLaVA等更有能力的模型进行检查和微调,以便驱动视频字幕和理解。 虽然这确实需要大量的计算资源和时间,但它应产生明显的结果。

blocks.en: We find that classical full fine-tuning, although computationally intensive yields the best results. The choice of adaptation method then becomes a conscious decision based on computational resources and time available to the user. Sometimes, simple prompt engineering can already lead to good results.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,古典式的全面微调,虽然在计算上是密集的,但效果最好。 然后,根据用户可利用的计算资源和时间,选择适应方法成为自觉的决定。 有时,简单的即时工程已经可以带来良好的效果.

blocks.en: Appendix A Appendix
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: A.1 Background on metrics
blocks.zh: A.1 衡量标准的背景

blocks.en: BLEU-4 : Bilingual Evaluation Understudy [ 16 ] is an inexpensive and language independent method of automatic machine translation evaluation that is used to evaluate quality of translated text by comparing it to one or more references. This is done by comparing n-grams in candidate translations to the references. BLEU-4 is the metric that focuses on 4-grams. It then takes the geometric mean and adds a brevity penalty to discourage shorter translation. Higher scores indicate better quality translations that closely match the reference texts in terms of word sequences.
blocks.zh: BLEU-4:双语评价 副研究[16]是一种成本低廉且语言独立的自动翻译评价方法,用于通过比较一个或一个以上引用来评价翻译文本的质量. 这样做的方法是将候选翻译中的正克与参考文献进行比较。 BLEU-4是注重4克的度量衡. 然后采用几何平均值,并增加一个简短的处罚,以劝阻缩短翻译。 较高的分数表明,在文字序列方面,译文质量更好,与参考文本非常吻合。

blocks.en: CIDEr : Consensus-based Image Description Evaluation [ 17 ] is a metric developed specifically for the evaluation of image captions generated by machine learning models. It measures the harmony, in a sense, between multiple reference captions and the generated caption. Unlike BLEU, which primarily focuses on n-gram overlaps, CIDEr considers both the similarity of individual words and their semantic relevance within the context of the image. In a way, it is n-gram similarity weighted with the TF-IDF score. Thus, this metric tends to correlate better with human judgments of caption quality, especially in scenarios where diversity and relevance are crucial.
blocks.zh: CIDER:基于共识的图像描述评价[17]是专门为评价机器学习模型生成的图像标题而开发的计量标准. 它从某种意义上衡量多个引用标题与生成标题之间的和谐. 与主要注重n-g重合的BLEU不同,CIDER既考虑单个单词的相似性,也考虑它们在图像上下文中的语义相关性. 从某种意义上说,它与TF-IDF的分数是n-g的类似加权. 因此,这一衡量标准往往与人类对标题质量的判断更加相关,特别是在多样性和相关性至关重要的情况下。

blocks.en: ROUGE-L : Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation - Longest Common Subsequence [ 18 ] is a metric commonly used in natural language processing tasks, such as summarization or translation. It evaluates the quality of summaries or translations by computing the "longest common subsequence" between the candidate summary and the reference summaries. ROUGE-L emphasizes on recall by measuring exactly what part of the reference summary is captured in the candidate string. A higher scores means that there is a larger overlap between candidate and reference, and consequently results in a better quality of translation.
blocks.zh: ROUGE-L:为Gisting Experience-Reception-Oriented Understanding for Gisting Experience - Lest Long Common Subsequence [18] 是自然语言处理任务中常用的度量衡,如归纳或翻译. 它通过计算候选摘要与参考摘要之间的"最长的常见子序列"来评价摘要或翻译的质量. ROUGE-L通过精确地衡量在候选字符串中记录的参考摘要的哪一部分来强调召回. 分数较高意味着候选人与参考资料之间重叠较大,因此翻译质量更高。

blocks.en: METEOR : Metric for Evaluation of Translation with Explicit Ordering [ 19 ] is a metric that evaluates a translation by computing a score based on word-to-word matches between the translation and a reference. It considers both the lexical and the semantic similarities. It does so, by computing a harmonic mean of precision and recall, weighted by a measure of alignment between words in the candidate and reference. Additionally, METEOR takes into account stemming, synonyms and word orders while evaluating the final score, making it highly robust to variations in language expression. A higher METEOR scores indicate better quality translations that capture both surface-level and semantic aspects of the reference text.
blocks.zh: METEOR:用明确顺序来评价翻译的衡量标准[19]是一个通过计算根据翻译与参考文献之间的字与字的比对得分来评价翻译的度量. 它既考虑了语法上的相似性,也考虑了语义上的相似性. 它通过计算精确和召回的调谐值,通过在候选词和参考词之间进行一定的对齐来进行加权。 此外,METEOR在评价最终得分时,还考虑到衍生词,同义词和词序,使其对语言表达方式的变异性非常强. 较高的METEOR分数显示,翻译质量较好,既能捕捉参考文本的表面水平,又能捕捉语义方面.
